WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

ABOUT THE GAME

 I’ve seen my death. This ain’t it.

 The midday sun blazes across the town, drawing sweat from your brow and setting your blood boiling. The air is thick with anticipation. Your fingers itch near the twin irons strapped to your hips. In this one street town, every spin is a duel between victory and death.

 This 5-reel, 4-row game with paylines offers a max win chance of up to {maximumWinMultiplier} times your bet in any game mode. Draw your pistol, and be the last gunslinger left standing, or you’ll be Dead by Noon.
